rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for amusing or pleasing someone.

example.english: I tell jokes to entertain people.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gong2 siu3 waa6 tam2 jan4 hoi1 sam1

rows.note: Use 招呼 when entertaining means hosting or looking after guests, not amusing them.

example.english: We plan to entertain a few friends at home tonight.
example.traditional: 今晚我哋喺屋企招呼幾個朋友。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 hai2 uk1 kei2 ziu1 fu1 gei2 go3 pang4 jau5

rows.note: Use 考慮 for entertaining an idea or proposal, rather than entertaining a person.

example.jyutping: nei5 go3 fong1 on3 ngo5 wui5 haau2 leoi6
